title: GCC core compile gate uses the shared bounded build governor

installed_sdk.rationale: This changes only CI build orchestration, its documentation, and a regression guard; no SDK header, target, symbol, or installed artifact changes.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No timeline CLI command, flag, or output contract changes.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation, schema, or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No runtime operation, executor binding, grant, or profile policy changes.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The change governs a compiler portability test and does not publish a design-time capability.
